composed:egintro:4152100066188604:8:0:te:
Pure Fiction contains a series of challenging stages. In this mode, you need to challenge the stages and earn the required number of points to pass the challenge and get splendid rewards. In addition, you will get bonus rewards for achieving specific targets. The difficulty and rewards of Pure Fiction stages are not affected by your Equilibrium Level.

Stages and rewards in Pure Fiction are regularly updated.

You will be cut off from the outside world when entering the Pure Fiction, with the following actions temporarily disabled:
● Changing team setup
● Changing, leveling up or ascending Light Cones and Relics
● Upgrading or ascending characters
● Using Consumables in your Inventory

In Pure Fiction, when ally characters defeat enemy targets, they regenerate only 50% of the Energy that they would normally do in regular battles.
composed:egintro:4152100066188604:8:1:te:
In the Pure Fiction challenge, non-Boss enemy units will continuously respawn after being defeated. Each time a non-Boss unit is defeated, the Boss unit's HP will be reduced. Defeating the Boss unit allows you to clear that wave.
With each update of Pure Fiction, a unique "Grit Mechanics" system is introduced. When triggered, it allows for rapid accumulation of Grit Value. Once fully charged, player enters the "Surging Grit" phase, gaining powerful stage buffs to defeat enemies!
composed:egintro:4152100066188604:8:2:te:
Methods to accumulate Grit Value includes:
● Defeat enemy units to earn a small amount of Grit Value.
● Trigger the Grit Mechanics in battle to earn a large amount of Grit Value.
composed:egintro:4152100066188604:8:3:te:
With each update of Pure Fiction, unique Grit Effects are introduced, divided into two different stage buffs: "Concordant Truce" and "Surging Grit."
● At the start of the battle, players are in the Concordant Truce phase, gaining initial buff effects.
● Upon entering the Surging Grit phase, players receive an additional powerful buff unique to that update.
● After the Surging Grit phase, has lasted for a certain amount of action value, the stage reverts to the Concordant Truce phase.
● During the Surging Grit phase, defeating enemy units accumulates "Resurging Tide." At the end of the Surging Grit phase, a portion of Grit Value is returned, up to a limit.
composed:egintro:4152100066188604:8:4:te:
Cacophony updates with various combat after each Pure Fiction update.
You can select one of the buffs for each team before challenging any stage in the Pure Fiction.
composed:egintro:4152100066188604:8:5:te:
In this mode, enemies will appear for a limited number of Cycles. Defeating enemies or dealing DMG to the Boss enemy earns you points.
Each stage contains two battles, namely Node 1 and Node 2. Your final points are the total points earned in both battles, and your highest points will be updated at the end of each battle.
composed:egintro:4152100066188604:8:6:te:
All stages in Pure Fiction that have been cleared with a 3-star rating are recorded. When a new event starts, all the cleared stages and their prerequisite stages will be immediately unlocked.
After Quick Unlock takes effect, You can directly challenge the last recorded stage that you passed with 3-stars. Once you have passed that stage with a 3-star rating, all the previous stages will be immediately cleared with a 3-star rating, and all rewards from those stages will be delivered to you.
Currently, only the first 3 stages can be quickly unlocked in this way.
composed:egintro:4152100066188604:8:7:te:
Clear Stage 3 of Pure Fiction to automatically unlock Starward Mode, and Stage 4 of Starward Mode will be unlocked.
● Clearing Stage 4 of Starward Mode requires challenging 3 Nodes, and 3-star challenge records are shared with Stage 4 of the Regular Mode.
● Clear Stage 4 of Starward Mode and obtain 99,000 points to obtain the Prismatic Star and additional new rewards.
● Accumulate 12 stars and the Prismatic Star to also obtain this period's Pure Fiction Limited-Time Clearance Medal.
● You can switch back to Regular Mode at any time to challenge Stage 4 of the regular Pure Fiction and obtain the original rewards.
composed:egintro:7039255158974959772:8:0:
Apocalyptic Shadow is a series of challenging game modes.
In Apocalyptic Shadow, you need to face the projection of the Finality and defeat the bosses and formidable foes you once faced.
Each period of Apocalyptic Shadow will update projections of 2 bosses, divided into 4 challenge difficulties.
Completing the challenge by defeating 2 bosses at the current difficulty level will allow you to claim generous rewards. Additionally, reaching specific scores can earn you bonus rewards. The difficulty and rewards of Apocalyptic Shadow stages are not affected by your Equilibrium Level.

Stages and rewards in Apocalyptic Shadow are regularly updated.

You will be cut off from the outside world when entering the Apocalyptic Shadow, with the following actions temporarily disabled:
● Changing team setup
● Changing, leveling up, or ascending Light Cones and Relics
● Upgrading or ascending characters
● Using consumables in your inventory.
composed:egintro:7039255158974959772:8:1: Apocalyptic Shadow has its unique rules, and there will be different stage effects during battles. Each period of Apocalyptic Shadow has its unique effects that only take effect within the current period.
composed:egintro:7039255158974959772:8:2:
In Apocalyptic Shadow, the projections of bosses and formidable foes differ from regular bosses, and you can read their traits at the beginning of the battle.
As the difficulty increases, new traits will be added to the bosses.
composed:egintro:7039255158974959772:8:3:
After each period of Apocalyptic Shadow updates, several Finality's Axiom buff effects will be added to each boss's challenge.
Before challenging the boss, you can choose one of these buff effects for each team.
composed:egintro:7039255158974959772:8:4:
The stage has an action value timer, and after each action by both sides, the corresponding action value will be deducted.
The scoring rules at the end of the stage are influenced by two factors: The remaining boss's HP and the remaining action value after successfully defeating the boss.
When a boss is successfully defeated, the score equals 100% of the boss's HP plus the remaining action value points when defeating the boss.
If the boss is not successfully defeated, only the percentage of the remaining boss's HP is calculated.
Each difficulty challenge consists of two battles, Node 1 and Node 2, and the final score is calculated based on the total score of the two battles. The current highest score for the difficulty level will be updated based on the score of this challenge.
composed:egintro:7039255158974959772:8:5:
After the stage challenge ends, the team lineup of this challenge will be recorded. Afterward, you can use this fixed team to challenge Node 1 or Node 2 separately, following these rules:
● Team members are fixed. Their Path will be fixed from the Path followed in the initial challenge. Their levels, Traces, and Eidolons will be fixed in the state of the latest repeat challenge. 
● The Light Cone of team members cannot be replaced and should be the one used in the initial challenge. If the Light Cone is not in the Inventory during the repeat challenge, the level of the Light Cone recorded during the initial challenge will be used.
● The Relics of team members cannot be replaced and should be the one used in the first challenge. If the Relics are not in the Inventory during the repeat challenge, the level and attributes of the Relics recorded during the initial challenge will be used.
After separately challenging Node 1 or Node 2, the total score of the two nodes will be used to update the current highest score of the difficulty level.
You can also use the Change Lineup function to replace characters, Light Cones, and Relics of the two teams and re-challenge Nodes 1 and 2. At this time, the scores of each node will be reset, but the current highest score of the difficulty level will not be reset.
composed:egintro:7039255158974959772:8:6:
The highest 3-star clearance difficulty of Apocalyptic Shadow will be recorded. After each subsequent period starts, the corresponding difficulty and all its prerequisite difficulties will be quickly unlocked based on the record.
After quick unlocking, you can directly challenge the recorded highest 3-star clearance difficulty. After clearing with 3 stars, it is considered to have cleared all prerequisite difficulties and obtain all rewards of the prerequisite difficulties.
This function can currently quick unlock up to the first 3 difficulties.
composed:egintro:7039255158974959772:8:7:
Clear Difficulty 3 of Apocalyptic Shadow to automatically unlock Starward Mode, and Difficulty 4 of Starward Mode will be unlocked. 
● Clearing Difficulty 4 of Starward Mode requires challenging 3 Nodes, and 3-star challenge records are shared with Difficulty 4 of Regular Mode.
● Clear Difficulty 4 of Starward Mode and obtain 10200 points to obtain the Prismatic Star and additional new rewards.
● Accumulate 12 stars and the Prismatic Star to also obtain this period's Apocalyptic Shadow Limited-Time Clearance Medal.
● You can switch back to Regular Mode at any time to challenge Difficulty 4 of the regular Apocalyptic Shadow and obtain the original rewards.
composed:egintro:7795447035405450900:7:0:
Anomaly Arbitration is a series of extremely difficult challenges.
In Anomaly Arbitration, you will play against powerful enemies to bring equilibrium back to the world.
Each period of Anomaly Arbitration will feature 3 Knight stages and 1 King stage. Protected by the Knight stages, the King's strength will be greatly enhanced, making it difficult to defeat. Completing the 3 Knight stages will return the King stage to its regular difficulty.
Complete the battles to claim rich rewards, and meet specific conditions to earn additional Star Rewards.
The difficulty and rewards of Anomaly Arbitration are not affected by your Equilibrium Level.

Stages and rewards in Anomaly Arbitration are regularly updated.

You will be temporarily cut off from the outside world when entering the Anomaly Arbitration, with the following actions temporarily disabled:
● Changing team setups
● Changing, leveling up, or ascending Light Cones and Relics
● Leveling up or ascending characters
● Using Consumables in your Inventory
composed:egintro:7795447035405450900:7:1: In Anomaly Arbitration, enemy materializations will have slight differences between them and regular enemies. Trailblazers can check out the details by reading about the enemies' traits when the battle begins.
composed:egintro:7795447035405450900:7:2:
After each period of Anomaly Arbitration updates, several Arbitral Quadrant buff effects will be added to each King's challenge.
Before challenging the King, you can choose one of these buff effects for the team.
composed:egintro:7795447035405450900:7:3:
In Anomaly Arbitration, every battle in the stage has its own independent Cycle limit. If the limit is exceeded during a challenge, it will be considered a failure. Clearing the battle within the designated number of Cycles and fulfilling specific conditions will grant a star rating for that stage.
In Anomaly Arbitration battles, the total action value of the first Cycle will be greatly increased, and the Cycle countdown will not reset when waves change.
When only a few Cycles remain, the team will be granted an additional combat buff at the start of each Cycle.
composed:egintro:7795447035405450900:7:4:
The 3 Knight Stages must be challenged using 3 different character teams, and you can decide the order in which you challenge them.
After completing each Knight Stage, a record of the team will be saved. You can then use this fixed team to re-challenge that stage, with the following rules for repeat challenges:
● Team members are fixed. Their Path, Level, Traces, and Eidolons are updated when re-challenging.
● If you replace a team member's Light Cone or Relics with a Light Cone or Relics that were recorded from another team's successful run, the challenge progress for the Knight Stage that has a record of that Light Cone or Relic will be reset.
● If you replace a team member's Light Cone or Relics with those of another member of the same team, or with a Light Cone or Relics that do not exist in any of the recorded successful runs, you can proceed directly with the Knight Stage challenge. In this case, you can choose upon successful completion whether to replace the old Battle Records and team information with the new ones.

You can also reassemble your team lineup, swapping out characters, Light Cones, and Relics to re-challenge a Knight Stage, which will reset the challenge's progress.
Characters, Light Cones, and Relics on unchallenged teams can be freely changed, but they cannot duplicate those on a cleared team. If they do, the cleared team's challenge progress will be reset.
When a challenge's progress is reset, the team record for that Knight Stage will be erased, and the score for that stage will be invalidated.

Each Knight Stage's rating is calculated independently upon completion.
When you clear the same Knight Stage multiple times, the different ratings you acquire will not be combined.
The best battle record is calculated based on the highest total rating from all three Knight Stages at the same time. This record is then used to determine your Star Rewards, and resetting challenge progress will not affect this best record.
composed:egintro:7795447035405450900:7:5:
In each Period's Anomaly Arbitration, there is only 1 King Stage, which can be challenged with any team.
It is recommended that you complete the Knight Stages first to restore the King Stage to its regular difficulty before challenging it.
If you directly defeat the King Stage on Plight difficulty, it will be considered as having cleared all three Knight Stages with 3 stars, and you will receive all the rewards from the Knight Stages.
composed:egintro:7795447035405450900:7:6:
Limited-time avatar frames and medals matching the star rating you achieve in the King Stage will be awarded.
● These limited-time avatar frames can be used during the current "Anomaly Arbitration" event.
● Medals can be equipped and displayed from the Collection Showcase in the Trailblazer's room. Medals will remain valid for 3 Anomaly Arbitration periods (including the current one). The specific validity is determined by the duration of the corresponding Anomaly Arbitration period.
composed:egintro:9326850012892598439:6:0:
The Forgotten Hall involves a number of challenging stages. Defeat all enemies in each stage of the Forgotten Hall to complete the challenge and claim gratifying rewards. In addition, bonus rewards can be obtained by fulfilling specific stage bonus conditions. Equilibrium Levels will not affect the difficulty and rewards in Forgotten Hall stages.

Stages and rewards in the Forgotten Hall are regularly updated.

Forgotten Hall contains two types of stages, "Memory" and "Memory of Chaos." The former involves stages that will be unlocked gradually as you continue your exploration, while the latter features stages of higher difficulty with content and rewards updated periodically.

You will be temporarily cut off from the outside world when entering the Forgotten Hall, with the following actions temporarily disabled:
● Changing team setups
● Changing, leveling up, or ascending Light Cones and Relics
● Leveling up or ascending characters
● Using Consumables in your Inventory
composed:egintro:9326850012892598439:6:1: The Forgotten Hall features unique rules, with each stage having a different stage effect that adds to the dynamics of combat, making each stage challenging in its own way.
composed:egintro:9326850012892598439:6:2:
All battles taking place in the Forgotten Hall must be won within a certain number of cycles. When you run out of cycles, the challenge will fail.
The remaining cycles will be displayed in the Action Order on the left-hand side as a countdown. Complete the challenge within the designated turns and meet specific stage bonus conditions to obtain bonus rewards.
composed:egintro:9326850012892598439:6:3:
The highest Memory of Chaos stage that you passed with 3-stars will be recorded. Whenever a new period starts, the recorded stage and all prior stages will be immediately unlocked according to your past performance.
After performing quick unlock, you can directly challenge the highest stage that you passed with 3-stars. Once you have passed that stage with 3-stars, all the previous stages will be immediately cleared with a 3-star rating, and all rewards from those stages will be delivered.
After the Starward Mode launches, no more than the first 10 stages can be immediately unlocked in this way.
composed:egintro:9326850012892598439:6:4: \nClear Stage 11 of Forgotten Hall to automatically unlock Starward Mode, and Stage 12 of Starward Mode will be unlocked.\n
composed:egintro:9326850012892598439:6:5:
● Clearing Stage 12 of Starward Mode requires challenging 3 Nodes, and 3-star challenge records are shared with Stage 12 of the Regular Mode.
● Clear Stage 12 of Starward Mode with 3 stars and 33 or more Cycles remaining to obtain the Prismatic Star and additional new rewards.
Accumulate 36 stars and the Prismatic Star to obtain this period's Forgotten Hall Limited-Time Clearance Medal.
● You can switch back to Regular Mode at any time to challenge Stage 12 of the regular Forgotten Hall and obtain the original rewards.
